I fully intend to finish this song with lyrics and an English vocal, where the chorus is "I want to waylay you .... Don't try to stop me."

upload_description_plain:
It's no joke I think Andrew Franco has some of the best Attribution 3.0 Pella's on the site 8^)

This is one I've been wanting to remix for a while, and when I started out I made a simple mistake that worked for me. I had a copy of TexasRadioFish's "Funk Change" in my sample folder when it was a full song... but as I listened to it I realized I could chop up the beat, a portion of the beat with a piano and the instrument solo section into a new song. So I made them the backing of this song. I used Duckett's "More Fake Jazz" to liven things up during the first half of the song, and some percussion elements form Peace Love Productions and one other source to make it all fit together. This is one of my favorite remixes.

upload_description_plain:
I wanted to try something in Latin love the sound when singing in choir.
So I wrote some quick poetic lyrics and ran them into a translator.
I don't know if translation is quite right so please forgive any errors,
feel free to add reverb splice etc. have fun with thank you.
Heres a translation of lyrics.
(English)
Send to me love eternal, great exalted one.
Your garden bears sweet fruit,
clothed in the rays of golden sunshine.
(Latin)
Dimitte me ut diligat aeterna, multa elatus. 
Hortum tuum invocatum est dulcis, 
indutus aureos radios solis.
File without reverb also available if wanted.
